description: The shared base only. The batch preset is for repos where every Renovate commit costs metered Actions minutes; this repo is public, so its Actions minutes are free and each update can have its own branch and its own run.

The base automerges minor, patch, pin and digest once CI is green on the branch, which is why the build workflow also runs on push to renovate/**. Without that trigger the branch carries no status check, and the base's own notes say such a branch only ever surfaces as a PR after 25 hours.

packageRules.description: Compose and Kotlin are a decision, not a bump. Focus on this launcher depends on Compose internals: which composable keeps focus, how a focus group is entered and left, and whether a tile pops out at all. A release has broken that before without a word in its notes, and the harness cannot see the panel. These go in one branch, get a PR, and are checked by hand on the set before merging.
The same, matched on the plugin id rather than the plugin marker artifact, because a plugin in a plugins{} block is read under its id.

The Android Gradle Plugin is checked by hand too, at every update type. It decides what is packaged, how it is shrunk and what is signed, and a release build that still assembles is not evidence that it still runs on an Android 10 set.
